route.note: Razorclaw the Butcher (floor 2, up the stairs)
Back down to the Courtyard: Commander Springvale (floor 1, west)
Odo the Blindwatcher on the Wall Walk (floor 7)
Up to Lord Godfrey's Chamber: Wolf Master Nandos (floor 6)
Archmage Arugal in the same chamber, final boss

pulls.note: Kennel: Rethilgore with a few adds; stun through Soul Drain.
Springvale with Guardsman and Servitor; Guardsman dies first.

strategies.text: Soul Drain stuns and drains the target; stun back when possible. Kill adds, then the boss.
Only Butcher Drain (drains a resource). Kill the adds first.
Veil of Shadow on the tank cuts healing received by 75% for 15 s; healers cover. Do not pull extra adds.
Paladin with stun, Holy Light and Divine Shield. Kill the Wailing Guardsman first, then the Haunted Servitor, then him.
Two Vile Bats cleave and disarm; kill them first and keep them off the group. Howling Rage ramps his damage, so keep the fight short.
Cleave and Hamstring. Do not pull with trash.
Toxic Saliva (poison) needs a cleanse; otherwise an easy melee fight.
Four wolves guard him; killing them pulls him. He summons a Bleak Worg or Lupine Horror: kill the summon, then him.

Void Bolt hits the tank hard, so the tank breaks line of sight during casts. Arugal's Curse mind-controls a player for 10 s: taunt the controlled player's target or crowd-control the player. He teleports (Shadow Port) and uses Thundershock.

notes: Floor numbering follows OpenMap's map list (1 Courtyard ... 7 Wall Walk) and the uiMapID table 310-316. Only Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale have OpenMap (Encounter Journal) pins. Rethilgore, Fenrus, Nandos, Arugal and Odo are estimates read off the tinted boss rooms on the map picture; Razorclaw and the Deathsworn Captain have no position (floor of Razorclaw is also unsourced; floor 1 is a placeholder). NeedRoll was used only as a cross-check. Stair/door transitions between floors are not on the map art, so the route lists boss order only. Forever's loot adds new items (Sorcerer Collar, Blade of Silverlaine, ...) but no layout change was reported. Quest givers are all outside; Arugal drops the Head of Arugal (itemID 5442). Method mentions the Black Tome in Arugal's room (used for the City of Dalaran key chain).
